name: LocalTrader price-manager missing access control
summary: The LocalTrader price-manager implementation exposed ownership and token-price setters without effective access control. A fresh EOA changed both values, acquired the exchange's LCT inventory for a negligible BNB payment, and exchanged the LCT against the protocol's LCT/WBNB liquidity.
notes: The price-manager proxy was directly created with its EIP-1967 implementation slot selecting 0x312dc37075646c7e0dba21df5bdfe69e76475fdc. The slot and selected 3,367-byte implementation runtime remain unchanged through the pre-incident state, and the proxy emits no canonical pre-incident Upgraded event. Proxy deployment is therefore the latest age reset for the implicated implementation.

Gross loss uses the LocalTrader exchange 0xce3e12bd77dd54e20a18cb1b94667f3e697bea06 and LCT/WBNB pair 0x64b266cd63ff3239e6491d6c2c58a5b8552c8724 as one victim set. The exchange receives 0.000000000032650797 BNB and sends 32,650,797 LCT; the final swap sends exactly the same LCT into the pair and removes 379.322744715267840729 WBNB. LCT is internal to the victim set and cancels rather than requiring an illiquid-token valuation. Subtracting the linked BNB input gives 379.322744715235189932 BNB of exact underlying depletion. Archive exchange balances reproduce its leg. The final receipt reproduces the pair leg; unrelated transactions in the same block supply 117.026153119475717607 WBNB net, so the pair's archive balance reconciles as 835.992277421314929535 + 117.026153119475717607 - 379.322744715267840729 = 573.695685825522806413 WBNB. The three approval transactions have zero victim flow but remain inside the complete consecutive-nonce campaign. The closest preceding DefiLlama BNB observation is $313.66 at 1684841863, 79 seconds before the anchor. Exact loss is $118,978.37210738067, replacing the seed's rounded $120,445 estimate.
